name: Esperanza,  Auberge Collection

address.street: Carretera transpeninsular 1 Mz 10 Km 7 Punta Ballena

insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary commands the most dramatic coastline in Los Cabos, where the Sea of Cortez meets rugged granite formations in a display of raw natural beauty.
whats_special: Esperanza sits on Punta Ballena, one of the few swimmable beaches on the Pacific side of Cabo. The resort's infinity pools seem to spill directly into the ocean, and every suite features floor-to-ceiling windows framing the endless blue horizon. The property's spa is built into natural rock caves, offering treatments with the sound of crashing waves as your soundtrack.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at Cocina del Mar - the restaurant's terrace offers front-row seats to Cabo's legendary sunsets, and the locally-caught dorado is exceptional.
dont_miss: The weekly beach barbecue where local mariachi bands perform against the backdrop of crashing waves, and the hotel's private snorkeling cove where you can spot tropical fish just steps from your suite. The nearby Arch of Cabo San Lucas is best viewed from the resort's whale watching excursions during migration season (December-April).
pros: Dramatic clifftop location with panoramic Sea of Cortez views
Award-winning Cocina del Mar restaurant with farm-to-table cuisine
Adults-only atmosphere ensuring peaceful luxury experience
Exceptional spa services with oceanfront treatment rooms
cons: Adults-only policy excludes families with children
